protocol.score_rule: high score = known; reject if score < tau; identity = nearest prototype identity
protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC(-score)

constraint.calibration: tau(A) = (1-A) quantile of the fold inner-OOF known scores; bisect A on the Train side so that the pooled (micro) LOSO unknown rejection equals 0.90. Bisection keeps the LOOSEST A whose rejection is still >= 0.90, which maximises Test S2 within the constraint.
constraint.selection: Among candidates whose achieved LOSO rejection lies in [0.90, 0.91], the frozen one is the one with the highest Test S2 acceptance.
constraint.reported_gap: max(0, 0.90-LOSO) + max(0, 0.70-S1) + max(0, 0.70-S2), the E226/E227 three-metric gap, reported only as a distance to the abandoned joint target.

deploy.score_rule: score = -min euclidean distance to same-task prototypes; identity = nearest prototype identity (frozen E226 rule).
